Google Assistant's days have been numbered ever since Gemini arrived on the scene, and its time is now up.

With coding as a key capability for AI companies, Meta throws its hat into the ring.
Meta’s new open-weight Muse Glimmer model offers a glimpse of Mark Zuckerberg’s personal superintelligence vision, as well as the emerging divide between AI users can own and access.
The terminal-based coding tool is powered by a new AI model, Muse Spark 1.2.
OpenAI and Anthropic models went on a hacking spree when tested by the UK's AI research institute
The UK AI Security Institute says OpenAI's and and Anthropic's models engaged in deceptive behavior and harmful activity during testing.
Advanced AI models developed by OpenAI and Anthropic went rogue during a cybersecurity test and showed a new type of risk posed by the technology, according to the UK’s AI Security Institute.
